items.computation: This is a company letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery fiction (like §122 AO) applies; the period runs from actual receipt (Zugang). The exact delivery day is not stated, so the letter's own date, 19.04.2027 (a Monday), is used as the earliest plausible start (assuming same-day or very fast delivery). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of receipt is not counted; the 3-month period (§188 Abs.2 BGB) then ends on 19.07.2027, a Monday (no weekend/holiday shift needed). If the letter actually arrived later than 19.04.2027, the 3-month deadline moves back by the same number of days.
